dc_eval_cbrn.quote:
Without mitigations, we do not rule out the model reaching this threshold in the Chemical &
Biological domain.
dc_eval_cbrn.locator: 4. Risk assessments; CBRN Capability Evaluations table
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Threshold determination plus scores (SecureBio VCT 55.9%, LAB-Bench etc.).

dc_eval_cyber.quote:
Our evaluations put the
unmitigated model at “moderate or lower” for both Cybersecurity and Loss of Control
before applying our mitigations.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: 'Loss of Control' evaluations are honesty (MASK) and agentic misalignment, coded as scheming; no replication, AI R&D or self-improvement risk evaluated. 'Research and development' is an intended use.

dc_eval_scheming.quote:
MASK assesses whether the model maintains honesty when pressured to contradict its baseline
knowledge, a property relevant to reliable oversight.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Honesty and agentic-misalignment (avoid shutdown) evals framed as loss of control; results MASK 87.3%, Agentic Misalignment 0%.

framework_threshold.quote:
With mitigations in
place, we assessed residual risk at the moderate or lower threshold.
framework_threshold.note: Model placed against Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework thresholds.

ext_test_any.note: Third parties developed/licensed benchmarks and outside experts did threat modeling; government entities gave input. Third-party results (Datacurve, Artificial Analysis) are capability benchmarks only (v1.1 #2). No outside testing of this model stated.

ext_test_named_org.note: SecureBio, Faculty.AI named as benchmark developers, not testers of this model; Datacurve/Artificial Analysis capability benchmarks only.

ext_test_government.note: 'engaged with government entities' whose input informed evaluations: generic engagement, not testing.
